name: CharacterCounter
purpose: Character count against the note limit. Switches to the danger tone when the count passes nearRatio of the limit (1800 of 2000 in the reference). Kept as its own widget (A) because the threshold switch is a felt behaviour; built from Text size xs, tabular numbers. B folds it to Text.

props.name: nearRatio
props.description: Share of the limit where the danger tone starts. Default 0.9.

states: near limit (danger tone, count above nearRatio of limit)
role: none. Optionally a polite status when the threshold is crossed.
platform: Same component. Desktop uses it in the capture bar note field (capture is desktop only); both platforms use it in the task inspector note editor.
open: 1) Confirm the threshold: the reference says chars > 90% of maxLength (strictly greater than nearRatio times limit). 2) Whether screen readers are told when the limit is approached: suggest a polite status only on crossing the threshold.
